subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that different animals appear in the water and make different sounds!

validationItems.failureText: Check to make sure the animal image selected in the <picture is equal to image> comparison block matches the sound that the animal makes in the [say] block.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Does the conditional check that the correct parameter is greater than the other?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where should the (length of array) and (array of all tile locations) blocks be placed, so that the conditional checks if the score is greater than the number of blue tile locations?


Solution: 

The (length of array) and (array of all tile locations) blocks are swapped with the (score) bubble in the [if then] conditional.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the game ends immediately! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the game ends only when the score is greater than the number of blue tile locations on the tilemap.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of Orange Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about user input, variables, and arrays.
